models.name: hrm_platform_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device fingerprint for unauthenticated platform access.

Guest accounts provide limited platform access without requiring full registration. Each guest is uniquely identified by their device fingerprint, enabling session continuity across visits. Guest accounts are temporary and can be converted to member accounts through registration.

Related to {@link hrm_platform_guest_sessions} which tracks individual login sessions for guests.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Unique device identifier used to recognize returning guests across sessions without requiring authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: hrm_platform_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest users with expiration tracking.

Stores connection metadata including IP address, request URL, and referrer for audit purposes. Each session has a defined expiration time after which it becomes invalid. Sessions are created when guests access the platform and are used to maintain temporary state across requests without requiring full authentication.

Related to {@link hrm_platform_guests} as the parent actor entity. Multiple sessions can exist per guest, but only the most recent active session is typically used.

foreignFields.name: guest_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged guest's {@link hrm_platform_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the current page request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the request originated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp after which the session is invalid.

models.name: hrm_platform_members
models.description: Registered member accounts with email and password authentication credentials. Each member represents a unique user identity that can belong to multiple organizations and maintain a global profile shared across all organizational contexts. Members authenticate via email/password and establish sessions for platform access. The profile attributes (display name, avatar, phone) are global and consistent regardless of which organization context the member is currently working in.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for authentication and account communication. Serves as the primary login credential.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication. Never stores plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name shown across all organizations and in the global profile. Used for identification in the UI.

plainFields.name: avatar_url
plainFields.description: Profile avatar image URL. Shared globally across all organizations the member belongs to.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for the user. Optional field for account recovery or communication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the account is deactivated but historical data is preserved.

models.name: hrm_platform_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

This table tracks authenticated login sessions for members (hrm_platform_members). Each record represents a distinct authentication session with associated JWT tokens and connection metadata.

Key characteristics:
- Sessions are created upon successful member login
- Access tokens are used for API authentication
- Refresh tokens enable token renewal without re-authentication
- Connection metadata (IP, href, referrer) provides audit trail
- Sessions expire based on expired_at timestamp

Related entities:
- {@link hrm_platform_members} - The member who owns this session

API generation: Session lifecycle endpoints (create, list, revoke) bound to member authentication flows.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for API authentication.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for token renewal without re-authentication.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the client request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security enforcement.

models.name: hrm_platform_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery.

Stores temporary tokens generated when members request password reset. Each token has an expiration time and can be used only once. After successful password change, the token is marked as used or expires automatically. Supports secure account recovery flow without requiring current password verification.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to member's email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was consumed for password reset. Null if not yet used.

models.name: hrm_platform_organizations
models.description: Core organization entity representing a multi-tenant workspace. Each organization operates independently with its own employees, projects, departments, and data. Organizations are owned by members who can configure settings, manage members, and control the organization lifecycle. When deleted, all associated business data (employees, projects, tasks, timelogs, timesheets) is permanently removed while the owner's member account remains intact.

foreignFields.name: owner_id
foreignFields.description: Owner member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}. The member who created and owns this organization. Can transfer ownership or delete the organization.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name displayed in the UI and used for identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description explaining the organization's purpose or business context.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: URL to the organization's logo image for branding and UI display.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW) used for financial calculations and reporting within the organization.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., Asia/Seoul, America/New_York) used for date/time calculations and timesheet week boundaries.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Month number (1-12) when the organization's fiscal year begins, used for annual reporting and budget cycles.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was soft-deleted. Null if active. Used for cascade deletion tracking.

models.name: hrm_platform_employees
models.description:
Employee records representing organizational membership, linking users to organizations with role assignments, department affiliations, and employment details.

Each employee record connects a {@link hrm_platform_members} user account to a specific {@link hrm_platform_organizations} organization, establishing their membership and access context. Employees are assigned exactly one {@link hrm_platform_roles} role that determines their permissions within the organization, and optionally belong to a {@link hrm_platform_departments} department for organizational structure.

The display_name field is denormalized from the member's global profile to enable efficient employee search and filtering without requiring joins. Employment type categorizes the worker relationship (full-time, part-time, contractor, intern), while status tracks whether the employee is currently active or deactivated.

A unique constraint on (member_id, organization_id) ensures each user can have only one employee record per organization. Soft deletion via deleted_at allows employees to be deactivated and potentially reactivated while preserving historical data like timelogs and timesheets.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: role_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned role's {@link hrm_platform_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: department_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned department's {@link hrm_platform_departments.id}.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Employee's display name denormalized from member profile for search and filtering efficiency.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Job title or position within the organization.

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Employment classification: full-time, part-time, contractor, or intern.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Employment status: active or deactivated. Deactivated employees cannot log time or submit timesheets but historical data is preserved.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee was deactivated (soft delete). Null means active.

models.name: hrm_platform_employee_contracts
models.description:
Employment contracts tracking pay rate, period, working hours, and start/end dates for employees.

Each employee can have multiple contracts throughout their employment history, but only one contract can be active at a time. When a new contract is created, the previous active contract is automatically ended. Past contracts are immutable historical records that cannot be edited.

The end_date field being null indicates an ongoing contract with no specified end date. The pay_period field stores the compensation frequency (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly), and working_hours_per_week defines the expected weekly working hours.

This table is managed through the {@link hrm_platform_employees} entity - users with employee:manage permission create and edit contracts for specific employees.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee's {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Contract start date. Required field marking when the employment terms begin.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Contract end date. Null value indicates an ongoing contract with no specified end date.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: Pay rate amount. Numeric value representing compensation per pay period unit.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: Pay period frequency. Allowed values: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: Expected working hours per week. Defines the standard weekly working schedule (e.g., 40).

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional notes or additional terms for the contract.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the contract record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the contract record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null indicates active record, non-null indicates deleted record retained for audit.

models.name: hrm_platform_departments
models.description:
Organizational departments for grouping employees within an organization. Supports one-level hierarchical structure through optional parent department reference.

Departments are managed by users with org:manage permission and serve as organizational units for employee classification. Each department belongs to exactly one organization and can have an optional parent department for basic hierarchy.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link hrm_platform_organizations} via organization_id
- Optional parent department via self-referential parent_id (one level only)
- Referenced by {@link hrm_platform_employees} for employee department assignment
- Referenced by {@link hrm_platform_employee_department_histories} for tracking department changes

When a department is deleted, employee department references are set to null rather than cascading deletion, preserving employee records.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent department's {@link hrm_platform_departments.id} for one-level hierarchy. Null for top-level departments.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department name. Must be unique within the organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description explaining the department's purpose and responsibilities.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the department was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the department was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the department was soft deleted. Null for active departments.

models.name: hrm_platform_roles
models.description:
Custom roles defined by organization owners with permission sets.

Roles represent access control profiles within an organization. Three built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) are system-defined and cannot be deleted. Organization owners can create custom roles with specific permission combinations.

Each role belongs to exactly one {@link hrm_platform_organizations} and can be assigned to multiple {@link hrm_platform_employees}. Role permissions are defined in the child table {@link hrm_platform_role_permissions}.

Built-in roles have the built_in flag set to true and are protected from deletion. Custom roles can be deleted only when no employees are currently assigned to them.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the role (e.g., Owner, Manager, Employee, or custom role name).

plainFields.name: built_in
plainFields.description: Whether this is a built-in system role that cannot be deleted. Built-in roles include Owner, Manager, and Employee.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: hrm_platform_role_permissions
models.description:
Permission assignments for custom roles within organizations.

This table stores the set of permissions granted to each custom role. Each row represents a single permission code assigned to a role, enabling the role-based access control system. Custom roles are created by organization owners with specific permission sets that determine what actions employees assigned to that role can perform.

Permissions include: org:manage (edit organization settings), employee:manage (add/edit/deactivate employees), employee:view (view employee list), project:manage (create/edit/delete projects), project:view (view projects), time:manage (edit any timelog), time:approve (approve/reject timesheets), time:view_all (view all timelogs), report:view (access organization reports).

Related to {@link hrm_platform_roles} through the role_id foreign key. Multiple permission records reference the same role to form a complete permission set.

foreignFields.name: role_id
foreignFields.description: Custom role's {@link hrm_platform_roles.id} that this permission is assigned to.

plainFields.name: permission
plainFields.description: Permission code defining the specific access right granted to the role. Valid values: org:manage, employee:manage, employee:view, project:manage, project:view, time:manage, time:approve, time:view_all, report:view.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: hrm_platform_employee_department_histories
models.description: Historical records tracking employee department assignment changes for organizational audit and compliance. Each record captures a point-in-time department assignment, including when an employee was moved to a different department or had their department assignment removed. This append-only table provides a complete audit trail of organizational structure changes and employee movement within the organization. Related to {@link hrm_platform_employees} for the employee being tracked, {@link hrm_platform_departments} for the department assignment (nullable when removed from department), and {@link hrm_platform_members} for the user who made the change.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee whose department assignment changed. {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: department_id
foreignFields.description: Department that was assigned. Null when employee was removed from department. {@link hrm_platform_departments.id}

foreignFields.name: changed_by_id
foreignFields.description: Member who made the department assignment change. {@link hrm_platform_members.id}

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the department assignment change occurred.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit purposes.

models.name: hrm_platform_projects
models.description:
Project work containers within organizations for tracking work initiatives, budget utilization, and team assignments.

Projects serve as the primary work containers that employees are assigned to through project memberships. Each project has a lifecycle status (active, archived, or completed) that controls whether new timelogs can be recorded. Active projects accept new time entries, while archived or completed projects preserve historical data but prevent new timelogs.

Projects reference {@link hrm_platform_organizations} for multi-tenancy isolation and are linked to employees through the {@link hrm_platform_project_members} junction table. Project leads (members with project-lead role) can manage tasks within their assigned projects.

Key business constraints:
- Projects can only be deleted if they have no associated timelogs
- Color codes enable visual identification in UI components
- Budget hours support budget vs. actual tracking in reports

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Project name for identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of project scope and objectives.

plainFields.name: color_code
plainFields.description: Hex color code for UI display and visual identification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Project lifecycle status: active, archived, or completed. Active projects accept new timelogs; archived/completed projects preserve historical data only.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Optional total estimated budget hours for tracking budget utilization percentage.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Optional project start date for timeline tracking.

plainFields.name: ended_at
plainFields.description: Optional project end date or actual completion date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was soft deleted. Null means active.

models.name: hrm_platform_project_members
models.description:
Junction table associating employees with projects, storing role assignment that determines task management permissions within the project.

Each record represents an employee's membership in a project with a specific role. The role field distinguishes between regular members and project-leads, where project-leads have permission to manage tasks within their assigned project.

An employee can be assigned to multiple projects, and each project can have multiple members. The combination of employee and project is unique to prevent duplicate assignments.

Related entities: {@link hrm_platform_employees} for employee information, {@link hrm_platform_projects} for project details.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee's {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_project_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged project's {@link hrm_platform_projects.id}.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role within the project, either 'member' or 'project-lead'. Project-leads can manage tasks within their project while regular members cannot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was soft deleted for audit trail and data recovery.

models.name: hrm_platform_tasks
models.description: Work items within projects representing tasks or subtasks with status tracking, priority levels, and optional employee assignment. Tasks support one-level parent-child hierarchy for subtask organization. Each task belongs to a project and optionally to an employee who is a project member. Task status changes are recorded in {@link hrm_platform_task_histories} for audit trail.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_project_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged project's {@link hrm_platform_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned employee's {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}. Optional - tasks can exist without specific assignee.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task's {@link hrm_platform_tasks.id} for subtask hierarchy. One-level nesting only - subtasks cannot have their own subtasks.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title or summary. Required field that briefly describes the work item.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed task description explaining the work to be done. Optional field for additional context and requirements.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Task workflow status. Allowed values: open, in-progress, completed, closed. Status changes are recorded in task history.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task priority level. Allowed values: low, medium, high, urgent. Used for sorting and filtering task lists.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Estimated effort required to complete the task in hours. Optional field for project planning and budget tracking.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Target completion date for the task. Optional field used for deadline tracking and overdue notifications.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was created. System-managed field for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was last modified. System-managed field updated on each change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was soft-deleted. Null for active tasks. Enables task recovery and preserves referential integrity.

models.name: hrm_platform_task_histories
models.description:
Immutable audit records capturing task status changes with timestamp, old status, new status, and user attribution.

This table serves as a compliance and tracking mechanism for task workflow management. Every status transition on a task creates a new history record that cannot be modified or deleted.

Key relationships:
- Each record belongs to exactly one {@link hrm_platform_tasks} entry
- Each record is attributed to one {@link hrm_platform_members} user who made the change
- Multiple history records can exist for a single task, forming a chronological audit trail

Status values tracked: open, in-progress, completed, closed. The old_status field is nullable for the initial task creation record.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: The task whose status changed. {@link hrm_platform_tasks.id}

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The member who made the status change. {@link hrm_platform_members.id}

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: The previous status of the task before the change. Null for initial task creation records.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: The new status of the task after the change. Valid values: open, in-progress, completed, closed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the status change occurred. Serves as the chronological ordering field for the audit trail.

models.name: hrm_platform_timelogs
models.description:
Individual time entry records capturing work performed by employees.

Each timelog represents a discrete unit of work with a specific date, duration, and project assignment. Timelogs are the fundamental building blocks of time tracking, later grouped into weekly timesheets for approval workflows.

Key relationships:
- Owned by an {@link hrm_platform_employees} record (the employee who performed the work)
- Assigned to an {@link hrm_platform_projects} (required - all time must be tracked against a project)
- Optionally linked to an {@link hrm_platform_tasks} (specific work item within the project)
- Can be included in an {@link hrm_platform_timesheets} for weekly approval

Business constraints:
- Employees can only create timelogs for themselves
- Timelogs can only reference projects the employee is assigned to
- Task references must belong to the selected project
- Timelogs included in approved timesheets become locked (cannot be edited or deleted)

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who logged the time. {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project the work was performed on. {@link hrm_platform_projects.id}

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional specific task within the project. {@link hrm_platform_tasks.id}

foreignFields.name: timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Timesheet this timelog is included in, if any. {@link hrm_platform_timesheets.id}

plainFields.name: date
plainFields.description: Date when the work was performed (work date, not creation timestamp).

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Duration of work in minutes. Must be positive integer.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of what work was performed.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Whether this time entry is billable to the client. Defaults to true.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: hrm_platform_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly collections of timelogs owned by employees with submission and approval workflow states.

Timesheets group individual timelog entries into weekly periods (Monday to Sunday) for organizational approval workflows. Each timesheet tracks the complete lifecycle from draft creation through submission, review, and final approval or rejection.

Key relationships:
- Owned by {@link hrm_platform_employees} - each timesheet belongs to exactly one employee
- Reviewed by {@link hrm_platform_members} - optional reviewer who approves or rejects the timesheet
- Contains multiple {@link hrm_platform_timelogs} - timelogs reference their parent timesheet

Status workflow:
- draft: Employee is building the timesheet, can add/remove timelogs
- submitted: Employee has submitted for approval, locked pending review
- approved: Manager has approved, all timelogs are permanently locked
- rejected: Manager has rejected with reason, returns to draft status for resubmission

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee's {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}. Owner of this timesheet who creates and submits it for approval.

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewed member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}. The member who approved or rejected this timesheet. Null when timesheet is in draft or submitted status.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Week start date (Monday). Defines the beginning of the weekly period this timesheet covers. Combined with employee_id forms unique constraint to ensure one timesheet per employee per week.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: Week end date (Sunday). Defines the end of the weekly period this timesheet covers. Calculated as week_start_date + 6 days.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Timesheet workflow status. Values: draft (building), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (reviewer approved), rejected (reviewer rejected with reason). Controls timesheet mutability and timelog locking.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when employee submitted the timesheet for approval. Null when in draft status or when rejected and returned to draft.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when reviewer approved or rejected the timesheet. Null when timesheet is in draft or submitted status.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by reviewer when rejecting the timesheet. Required when status is rejected, null otherwise. Explains why the timesheet was rejected and what needs correction.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp. Automatically set when timesheet record is first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp. Automatically updated on every modification to track changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active, set to deletion timestamp when soft deleted. Allows data recovery if needed.

models.name: hrm_platform_timers
models.description: Active time tracking sessions that employees start to track work in real-time. Each timer records the start timestamp, assigned project, optional task, and description of work being performed. When stopped, the timer converts to a timelog entry with calculated duration. Employees can have at most one active timer at a time. Running timers can be edited (description, project, task) or discarded without creating a timelog.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns this timer session. {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project being tracked. {@link hrm_platform_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task being tracked within the project. {@link hrm_platform_tasks.id}.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was started.

plainFields.name: stopped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was stopped. Null while timer is running. Used to calculate duration when converting to timelog.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the work being tracked. Can be edited while timer is running.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer was soft deleted. Null if active. Enables data recovery and audit trail.

plainIndexes.description: Composite index for efficiently querying active timers (stopped_at IS NULL) and stopped timers per employee.
Index for querying timers by start time, useful for finding long-running timers.

ginIndexes.description: Full-text search index on timer description for finding timers by work description.

models.name: hrm_platform_activity_logs
models.description:
System-wide audit trail recording significant organizational actions for compliance and forensic analysis.

Captures who performed what action, when, and on which entity across all business domains including employee lifecycle events (invited, deactivated, reactivated), contract changes (created, edited), project operations (created, archived, completed, deleted), task status changes, timesheet workflow (submitted, approved, rejected), and role assignments. Each log entry attributes the action to a specific member within an organization context and references the target entity that was affected.

Referenced by users with org:manage permission for viewing full activity history. Supports filtering by action type, user, and date range for targeted audit queries.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who performed the action. {@link hrm_platform_members.id}

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context where the action occurred. {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of action performed. Examples: employee.invited, employee.deactivated, employee.reactivated, contract.created, contract.edited, project.created, project.archived, project.completed, project.deleted, task.status_changed, timesheet.submitted, timesheet.approved, timesheet.rejected, role.assigned, role.changed

plainFields.name: target_entity_type
plainFields.description: Type of entity that was acted upon. Examples: employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, role, department

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the target entity that was acted upon. References the ID of the entity specified in target_entity_type.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional context about the action including old/new values, reasons, or other relevant metadata.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the action occurred.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was last updated. Maintained for schema consistency though audit logs are typically immutable.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Allows compliance-driven retention policies while preserving audit trail integrity.
